<think>**Selecting grouped decoder design**

**Factoring decoder into pairs**

**Choosing pair decomposition**

**Comparing timing paths**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);

    wire [7:0] pair_ab;
    wire [7:0] pair_cd;
    wire [7:0] pair_ef;
    wire [7:0] pair_gh;
    wire [7:0] pair_ij;
    wire en_ab, en_cd, en_ef, en_gh, en_ij, en_default;

    assign pair_ab = sel[0] ? block_b : block_a;
    assign pair_cd = sel[0] ? block_d : block_c;
    assign pair_ef = sel[0] ? block_f : block_e;
    assign pair_gh = sel[0] ? block_h : block_g;
    assign pair_ij = sel[0] ? block_j : block_i;

    assign en_ab = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1];
    assign en_cd = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2] &  sel[1];
    assign en_ef = ~sel[3] &  sel[2] & ~sel[1];
    assign en_gh = ~sel[3] &  sel[2] &  sel[1];
    assign en_ij =  sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1];
    assign en_default = sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]);

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{en_ab}} & pair_ab)
                  | ({8{en_cd}} & pair_cd)
                  | ({8{en_ef}} & pair_ef)
                  | ({8{en_gh}} & pair_gh)
                  | ({8{en_ij}} & pair_ij)
                  | ({8{en_default}} & block_a);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The critical path is expected to involve select decoding and the wide output-selection reduction. A flat implementation can require ten decoded data terms per output bit.",
  "rewrite": "Factor selection into five parallel two-input data muxes controlled by sel[0], followed by a six-term masked OR. Decode sel[3:1] once across all eight output bits. Select block_a directly for the three upper-select groups representing values 10 through 15.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The reduced final reduction width and three-bit group decoding may reduce maximum arrival time. The extra local mux stage is a tradeoff; a timing improvement is not guaranteed without mapping and static timing analysis under the specified conditions.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses forty bit-level local muxes plus shared group decoding and eight six-term output reductions. This trades local mux area for fewer final selection terms. Mapped area and compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap, as well as electrical constraints, require tool verification.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, ports, unsigned widths, combinational behavior, and all sixteen two-state select cases. Values 0 through 9 select block_a through block_j; values 10 through 15 select block_a independently of sel[0]. No storage, latency, assumptions, external dependencies, or parameters are introduced. Four-state X/Z simulation equivalence is not claimed."
}
